cleaning.historical_description_as_published: At EcoCare, we bring a fresh perspective to cleanliness with services that cater to homes, offices, and industrial spaces. Our residential cleaning transforms your living environment into a pristine sanctuary, focusing on every detail to ensure freshness and comfort. For businesses, our office and commercial cleaning services deliver professional results that promote productivity and make a lasting impression. Whether it's routine maintenance or deep cleaning, we ensure every corner shines with unparalleled precision. Our expertise extends to specialized cleaning solutions like carpet and upholstery care. Using advanced techniques, we remove dirt, allergens, and tough stains, restoring carpets to their vibrant appearance and breathing new life into furniture. These services not only enhance aesthetics but also promote healthier indoor air quality. Additionally, our tile and grout cleaning restores the beauty of tiled surfaces, making them look as good as new, while our curtain and drapery cleaning ensures window treatments are free from dust and allergens. For industrial environments, we offer comprehensive industrial cleaning services tailored to demanding spaces like warehouses and manufacturing plants. We tackle heavy-duty grime and debris, creating cleaner, safer, and more efficient workspaces. Our post-construction cleaning ensures newly built or renovated spaces are ready for occupancy, while our move-in and move-out cleaning provides stress-free transitions with sparkling results. At EcoCare, cleanliness goes beyond appearances. Our sanitization and disinfection services deliver an added layer of safety, protecting you from harmful pathogens. Combining eco-friendly practices, innovative techniques, and a commitment to excellence, we take pride in creating spaces that enhance your quality of life. With EcoCare, trust that your home, office, or industrial space will be cleaner, safer, and more inviting than ever.

pest.historical_description_as_published: EcoCare’s Fumigation and Pest Control services are designed to provide a safe and healthy environment by effectively eliminating pests and preventing future infestations. Our expert team uses eco-friendly and safe methods to rid your space of unwanted insects, rodents, and other pests. Whether you're dealing with termites, mosquitoes, cockroaches, or rodents, we have specialized treatments that target specific pests to ensure long-lasting results. Our fumigation services are particularly beneficial for commercial spaces, residential homes, and warehouses where a thorough treatment is required to eradicate pests from hard-to-reach areas. We use advanced fumigation techniques and products that penetrate deep into the structures, ensuring the removal of all pests without the need for harsh chemicals. EcoCare is committed to providing pest control solutions that are both effective and safe for the environment, pets, and family members. In addition to fumigation, we offer preventative pest control services that can be scheduled regularly to keep your home or business free from future infestations. Our team will assess your property, identify potential risk areas, and implement preventive measures to keep pests at bay. This service is ideal for homeowners, office buildings, and restaurants looking to maintain a clean, safe, and pest-free environment. For specific pest issues, EcoCare offers customized treatment plans that include sealing entry points, eliminating nests, and applying treatments in targeted areas. Our experts will ensure that your home or office is thoroughly protected, and we provide guidance on how to maintain a pest-free space moving forward. Whether you're dealing with a major pest issue or simply want to safeguard your property, EcoCare’s Fumigation and Pest Control services offer the peace of mind that comes with a clean, pest-free environment.

carpet.historical_description_as_published:
At EcoCare, we believe your carpets are more than just a decorative element—they’re a vital part of your home or workspace. Over time, carpets collect dirt, allergens, stains, and odors that not only tarnish their appearance but also affect the cleanliness and health of your environment. That’s why our professional carpet cleaning service is designed to rejuvenate your carpets, leaving them fresh, spotless, and like new.

We use advanced cleaning techniques tailored to the specific needs of your carpets. Whether it’s hot water extraction (steam cleaning), dry cleaning, or encapsulation, our methods penetrate deep into the carpet fibers to remove embedded dirt and tough stains. Our eco-friendly, non-toxic cleaning solutions ensure that while your carpets get a thorough clean, your family, pets, and the environment remain safe.

Our highly skilled technicians bring years of experience and expertise to every job. They carefully inspect your carpets to determine the best cleaning approach, ensuring delicate materials are preserved while heavily soiled areas receive extra care. Whether dealing with high-traffic zones, pet stains, or old spills, our team restores your carpets to their original brilliance.

The cleaning process begins with a detailed assessment, followed by pre-treatment of stubborn stains and heavily soiled areas. We then deep clean your carpets using cutting-edge equipment that extracts dirt, allergens, and bacteria, leaving them hygienically clean. Afterward, a deodorizing step eliminates odors, leaving your carpets smelling fresh and inviting.

Our services don’t just improve the appearance of your carpets—they contribute to a healthier environment. By removing allergens and bacteria, we help improve air quality and create a safer living or working space. Regular professional cleaning also extends the life of your carpets, protecting your investment and maintaining the beauty of your interiors.

upholstery.historical_description_as_published:
EcoCare owns some of the world’s famous cleaning equipment. Our Carpet and upholstery machines work on the same principle as a washing machine effecting deep into the fibres of the carpet and upholstery. With our cleaning machines especially formulated detergent designed to loosen accumulated dirt from the carpet piles and chair fabrics. Detergents are mixed with warm water and sprayed into the carpets and chairs using the similar equipment, in the process the dirt is loose as a result of the reaction of this detergent and extracted from the chairs and carpet.
								Unlike other conventional cleaners, our equipment are designed to extract all the dirt including that which has found its way deep down in the carpet or upholstery due to lack of proper equipment. The extraction ensures that the carpet and upholstery is 90% dry preventing dampness, smell and staining.

At EcoCare, we understand that your upholstered furniture plays a vital role in your home or office, providing comfort, elegance, and functionality. Over time, however, daily use can lead to dirt, stains, and allergens embedding themselves into the fabric, making it look worn and reducing its lifespan. Our upholstery services are designed to breathe new life into your furniture, ensuring it remains clean, fresh, and inviting while extending its durability. The process begins with a detailed inspection of your furniture to identify the type of fabric and assess its condition. This ensures we use the right cleaning method for the best results. We then prepare the surface by vacuuming away dirt and dust, focusing on the fabric and crevices where debris tends to accumulate. For tougher stains, we employ eco-friendly, fabric-safe solutions to gently lift them without causing damage. Our deep cleaning methods include steam cleaning, which penetrates the fibers to remove dirt, bacteria, and allergens, or dry cleaning for more delicate fabrics. This not only restores the furniture’s original look but also contributes to a healthier indoor environment. For leather furniture, we go a step further, applying premium conditioners that restore softness, prevent cracking, and enhance the natural shine. To keep your furniture protected, we offer fabric treatments that create a barrier against future stains and wear, ensuring that your investment lasts longer. Once the cleaning process is complete, we finish with a refreshing deodorizer to leave your furniture smelling as good as it looks. Before we leave, our team conducts a final inspection to make sure everything meets the highest standards of quality. Choosing EcoCare means choosing excellence. We combine advanced cleaning techniques with environmentally friendly products to deliver unmatched results. Whether it’s your favorite sofa, office chairs, or even leather recliners, we provide comprehensive care that revitalizes your furniture and uplifts your space. At EcoCare, we take pride in helping you create a clean and welcoming environment with furniture that looks and feels brand new.

legacy_policies.privacy_as_published:
EcoCare Cleaning Services Limited
Privacy Policy
Privacy Policy for EcoCare Cleaning Services
At EcoCare, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your personal information is handled securely and responsibly. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our services or visit our website.
We collect personal information such as your name, contact details, and service preferences to provide tailored services and respond to your inquiries. This information is collected when you fill out forms on our website, contact us via phone or email, or interact with us through any other communication channel.
Your information is used solely to deliver high-quality services, respond to your requests, and improve your experience with EcoCare. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties unless required to do so by law or with your explicit consent.
EcoCare ensures the security of your personal information through robust measures to prevent unauthorized access or disclosure. While we take every precaution to protect your data, please note that no method of electronic storage or transmission is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Our website may contain links to third-party websites for your convenience. Please be aware that we are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these external sites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of these websites before providing any personal information.
By using our services or website, you consent to the terms outlined in this privacy policy. EcoCare reserves the right to update or modify this policy at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page, and your continued use of our services signifies your acceptance of these updates.
If you have any questions or concerns about our privacy practices, please contact us directly through the contact details provided on our website. We value your trust and are dedicated to maintaining the privacy and security of your personal information.

Upholstery Services
Upholstery Services
Cleaning
Mile 7, Accra
Show all photos
Service Details
EcoCare owns some of the world’s famous cleaning equipment. Our Carpet and upholstery machines work on the same principle as a washing machine effecting deep into the fibres of the carpet and upholstery. With our cleaning machines especially formulated detergent designed to loosen accumulated dirt from the carpet piles and chair fabrics. Detergents are mixed with warm water and sprayed into the carpets and chairs using the similar equipment, in the process the dirt is loose as a result of the reaction of this detergent and extracted from the chairs and carpet.
Unlike other conventional cleaners, our equipment are designed to extract all the dirt including that which has found its way deep down in the carpet or upholstery due to lack of proper equipment. The extraction ensures that the carpet and upholstery is 90% dry preventing dampness, smell and staining.
At EcoCare, we understand that your upholstered furniture plays a vital role in your home or office, providing comfort, elegance, and functionality. Over time, however, daily use can lead to dirt, stains, and allergens embedding themselves into the fabric, making it look worn and reducing its lifespan. Our upholstery services are designed to breathe new life into your furniture, ensuring it remains clean, fresh, and inviting while extending its durability.
The process begins with a detailed inspection of your furniture to identify the type of fabric and assess its condition. This ensures we use the right cleaning method for the best results. We then prepare the surface by vacuuming away dirt and dust, focusing on the fabric and crevices where debris tends to accumulate. For tougher stains, we employ eco-friendly, fabric-safe solutions to gently lift them without causing damage.
Our deep cleaning methods include steam cleaning, which penetrates the fibers to remove dirt, bacteria, and allergens, or dry cleaning for more delicate fabrics. This not only restores the furniture’s original look but also contributes to a healthier indoor environment. For leather furniture, we go a step further, applying premium conditioners that restore softness, prevent cracking, and enhance the natural shine.
To keep your furniture protected, we offer fabric treatments that create a barrier against future stains and wear, ensuring that your investment lasts longer. Once the cleaning process is complete, we finish with a refreshing deodorizer to leave your furniture smelling as good as it looks. Before we leave, our team conducts a final inspection to make sure everything meets the highest standards of quality.
Choosing EcoCare means choosing excellence. We combine advanced cleaning techniques with environmentally friendly products to deliver unmatched results. Whether it’s your favorite sofa, office chairs, or even leather recliners, we provide comprehensive care that revitalizes your furniture and uplifts your space. At EcoCare, we take pride in helping you create a clean and welcoming environment with furniture that looks and feels brand new.

EcoCare Cleaning Services Limited
Privacy Policy
Privacy Policy for EcoCare Cleaning Services
At EcoCare, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your personal information is handled securely and responsibly. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our services or visit our website.
We collect personal information such as your name, contact details, and service preferences to provide tailored services and respond to your inquiries. This information is collected when you fill out forms on our website, contact us via phone or email, or interact with us through any other communication channel.
Your information is used solely to deliver high-quality services, respond to your requests, and improve your experience with EcoCare. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties unless required to do so by law or with your explicit consent.
EcoCare ensures the security of your personal information through robust measures to prevent unauthorized access or disclosure. While we take every precaution to protect your data, please note that no method of electronic storage or transmission is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Our website may contain links to third-party websites for your convenience. Please be aware that we are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these external sites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of these websites before providing any personal information.
By using our services or website, you consent to the terms outlined in this privacy policy. EcoCare reserves the right to update or modify this policy at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page, and your continued use of our services signifies your acceptance of these updates.
If you have any questions or concerns about our privacy practices, please contact us directly through the contact details provided on our website. We value your trust and are dedicated to maintaining the privacy and security of your personal information.
